title: SISO Foundry initial public source boundary

license.reason: The artifact contains reviewed SISO-owned software under MIT; large data and third-party source are referenced through manifests rather than included.

evidence.summary: Included paths, excluded assets, and ownership boundaries are recorded with the source.

addressable.reason: The public source is pinned to an exact commit.

evidence.summary: Published source commit resolves from the canonical repository.

archive_downloadable.reason: A public commit-scoped source archive is recorded; large datasets are intentionally separate.

evidence.summary: Immutable source archive locator resolves independently of the data plane.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The registry release resolves to its Work and pinned source artifact.

evidence.summary: Manifest cross-references and artifact identity validate.

installable.reason: The source and standalone topic-registry smoke are usable, but the complete platform requires an external Foundry data plane and domain-specific provider configuration.

evidence.summary: Source compilation, syntax checks, topic-registry smoke, dataset-manifest validation, and publication scan passed.

forkable.reason: The source repository is public, small, and MIT licensed; datasets are not hidden Git dependencies.

evidence.summary: Public source, license, architecture, provenance, and data boundary are present.

portable.reason: Personal paths were replaced by a portable FOUNDRY_DATA contract and narrower overrides, but the existing multi-gigabyte corpus has not yet received a portable snapshot receipt.

evidence.summary: Dataset classes, current observed scale, storage policy, and missing release receipts are explicit.
Canonical public main HEAD pinned to the initial source-and-data-boundary release.
Repository verification completed successfully after host-specific artifacts and symlinks were excluded.
